name: net
description: TCP over the system's sockets for a loop that serves many: a Listener and the Streams it accepts or that connect out, non-blocking, closed on exec or never inherited, no SIGPIPE; each owns its socket and its Owned entry in a wait Set, which close removes before the socket is closed, once; a Stream remembers how its connection went, and a read or write before it is made is NotConnected on every system; errors by kind, IPv4 and IPv6.
